meta.description: TR-22, Blueprint §10 flow 4. Mon 06:00: seal the prior ISO week -> render dept+company PDFs via the report-renderer sidecar -> notify the configured reports stakeholders with links. SEALING IS CALENDAR-ONLY BY CONSTRUCTION: this flow only ever computes a Monday-aligned week start and calls kind='week', so it can never reach report-seal.ts's 422 custom_kind branch. AI narratives are NOT a separate step here -- TR-15's sealPeriod (report-seal.ts) already builds every in-scope document's narrative (document-builder.ts's buildNarrative, a pure function that NEVER throws -- fail-soft by construction) as part of the ONE atomic seal call, and TR-27 (not yet landed) upgrades that same pure function to call ai-gateway-go with an unchanged never-throws contract, so nothing here needs to change when it does. IDEMPOTENT/RE-DRIVABLE: `POST .../seal` on an already-sealed period returns 409; rather than parse that error response, this flow re-fetches the period afterward and checks its stored `status` -- 'sealed' means someone/something already completed this exact seal (this flow's own earlier run, a human, or a genuine concurrent race) and the flow continues normally into render+notify, which is the ticket's own instruction: 'treat 409 as success-already-done, not as a failure to alert on'. Only a period that is STILL open after the recheck is treated as a genuine failure. Re-driving also re-renders PDFs (a fresh export job every time, matching TR-18/21's own non-deduped design) and re-sends the notify step -- a disclosed, harmless duplication, the same shape every other CRON flow in this repo already has (no notification in this codebase is deduplicated). 'Leads/exec' recipients are NOT resolved live from Cerbos role grants -- REPORTS_NOTIFY_USER_IDS is a static, configured, comma-separated user-id list (same shape as NOTIFY_USER_ID's existing 'the ops lead' convention already used by stale-approval-chaser/compliance-gate-nag/on-org-updated-notify), a disclosed scoping decision, not a hidden shortcut: a live per-department-lead resolution would need a NEW platform-nest read endpoint, and this ticket's own brief says to keep the platform-nest footprint to src/seed/automation.ts while another seat is actively building the appraisal engine in this same module -- see automation/README.md. The notification LINKS into the sealed document (`/reports?periodId=...&grain=...&scopeRef=...`, the exact href shape report-seal.ts's own amend-notify already uses) rather than embedding any KPI value, per §11's person-grain-data boundary. Env: PLATFORM_URL, PLATFORM_SERVICE_TOKEN, AGENCY_TENANT_ID, HUB_SERVICE_TOKEN, REPORTS_NOTIFY_USER_IDS.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { ok: true, periodId: $('Extract period').first().json.periodId, periodStart: $('Extract period').first().json.periodStart, periodEnd: $('Extract period').first().json.periodEnd } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ grain: $json.grain, scopeRef: $json.scopeRef, periodKind: 'week', start: $json.periodStart, format: 'pdf' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "notify", arguments: { tenantId: $json.tenantId, recipientId: $json.recipientId, type: $json.type, payload: { title: 'Weekly reports sealed', href: `/reports?periodId=${$json.periodId}`, body: `Week of ${$json.periodStart} to ${$json.periodEnd}: ${$json.links.length} report(s) sealed and rendered.` + ($json.failureCount ? ` ${$json.failureCount} scope(s) failed to render -- check the automation console.` : ''), entityType: 'report_period', entityId: $json.periodId, severity: $json.failureCount ? 'warning' : 'info', links: $json.links } } } }) }}
